text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
The spectators are enthralled by my<n>running! With a
swarm of reporters in<n>wait, I head to the press
conference<n>room...

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
Only to find a single journalist... plus<n>Doto! Alas, the
number of poor souls<n>wallowing in an abyss of
despair,<n>ignorant of my presence, appears far<n>too
great!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text:
My next goal is clear—a rescue. With<n>the Overlord's
gleaming stride, I will<n>turn the nescient masses into
my<n>fans!
